refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates or open a shared memory segment

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
SysvSharedMemoryfalseshm_attach intkey intnullsize&null; intpermissions0666
shm_attach returns an id that can be used to access the System V shared memory with the given key, the first call creates the shared memory segment with size and the optional perm-bits permissions.
A second call to shm_attach for the same key will return a different SysvSharedMemory instance, but both instances access the same underlying shared memory. size and permissions will be ignored.

&reftitle.parameters;
key
The System V IPC key of the shared memory segment, as given to shmget(); ftok can generate one.
size
The memory size of the whole segment, which includes a 40-byte header (on 64-bit platforms): the data area is smaller by that size, and a size below it fails when the segment does not exist yet. If not provided, default to the sysvshm.init_mem in the &php.ini;, otherwise 10000 bytes.
permissions
The optional permission bits, used only when the segment is created. Default to 0666, which lets every local user read and write the segment.
